newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal seen higher, soyoil seen flat-down.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal seen higher, soyoil seen flat-down.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures were called to open $0.50 to $1.00 per ton higher Wednesday in response to talk of export business, traders said.
There were market rumors that China was seeking U.S. soymeal for November shipment and there is continued talk of European demand for U.S. soymeal, traders said.
Soyoil futures were expected to follow soybeans to a flat to slightly lower open, and were called steady to 0.05 cent lower, traders said.
